julia_ng: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we need a concrete handover for SLO updates, dashboard remediations, and alert tweaks. Who's owning each piece and what's the timeline?

alex_chen: Split into 3 owners: (A) SLO threshold + error budget calc, (B) dashboard panels + visualizations, (C) alerting policies + runbook/playbook.

samir_patel: I'll own (A) — recalculating error budgets now and will propose revised P95 targets tonight. Creating a tracking ticket (REDWOOD-3245). ETA EOD.

maria_garcia: I'll take (B) — add "slo burn" panel, per-model breakdown, and a compact summary tile for oncall. ETA tomorrow morning. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/latency/overview

alex_chen: I'll handle (C) — update PagerDuty thresholds, add short runbook steps for mitigation and automatic rollback gating. Will draft runbook snippet for review.

samir_patel: Quick analysis notes: recurring latency spikes line up with batch job window at ~02:00 UTC. Current error-budget burn ~1.2%/week when spikes occur. Short-term mitigation: relax P95 to 220ms, long-term: capacity + dedicated pool plan.

julia_ng: Can you paste the PromQL you used for the burn calc so ops can validate?

samir_patel: ```promql
(sum(increase(requests_errors_total[7d]))) / (sum(increase(requests_total[7d])))
``` — that's the simple week-over-week error rate we used for the postmortem numbers.

maria_garcia: I'll add a panel using that query and a graph for `error_budget_left` metric. Proposed alert threshold for dashboard highlight: 2% burn over 7d.

oncall-bot: Incident tracker: REDWOOD-3245 created and assigned to samir_patel. Due date: 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC.

alex_chen: Recap of action items: samir -> PR with SLO doc + calculations (link in REDWOOD-3245), maria -> update Grafana and attach dashboards to ticket, alex -> update PagerDuty rules & runbook. Quick sync tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

julia_ng: Also add a deploy-gate: if P95 > 300ms for 10m during canary, block non-critical model rollouts. @infra-bot can you take care of infra gating?

infra-bot: Received request to add deploy-gate. Opening INFRA-1987 to implement canary block and automated rollback. ETA ~48h.

samir_patel: I'll add a canary config and low-latency variant test. PR coming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/789

maria_garcia: :thumbsup: once dashboards are live I'll link them in REDWOOD-3245 and mark progress.

julia_ng: Great. Please update the JIRA tickets and PRs as you make progress and ping this thread when done. Closing on my side after tomorrow's check-in unless anything urgent comes up. :eyes:
